title: Barefoot Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Barefoot Haven is a stunning four-bedroom retreat in the sought-after Seacrest Beach community, perfectly situated between Rosemary and Alys Beach along the iconic 30A. This spacious 3,000-square-foot home showcases all-new furnishings and gleaming hardwood floors, creating a modern yet warm atmosphere. The bright and open living, dining, and kitchen areas, highlighted by stained beams and expansive windows, invite relaxation and entertainment. The fully equipped kitchen, featuring a walk-in pantry and a breakfast bar, is perfect for gourmet cooking. With luxurious primary suites on both floors, each with a private bath and balcony, plus a stylish guest room and an inviting bunk room, Barefoot Haven offers an ideal setup for families and friends. This house and location are simply amazing!! Beautifully decorated beach home with all the amenities of home and then some! Plenty of space! Lots of beach chairs and umbrellas and boogie boards and bikes! The pool is super close and the beach just a short quaint walk through the neighborhood. I just can’t say enough good things! We did have a little issue with a broken bed when we arrived, BUT it was addressed quickly and handled very well. It was very reassuring to know that the support team was there to make our vacation the best! Can’t wait to come back!!!
